Supply applicable test jigs/accessories, standards compliance, full-use capability, itemized components, ready-to-use setup, manufacturer literature and calibration compliance.
Tensile jig complies with ASTM D4595; clamps span specimen width without slip/crush and jaw faces exceed specimen width (50–200 mm).
Tear jig complies with ASTM D4533; parallel flat gripping surfaces 50.8–76.2 mm, correct trapezoid template, 15–85% full-scale load and 300 ± 10 mm/min.

Puncture jig complies with ASTM D4833, including 45 ± 0.025 mm internal opening, at least 100 mm external diameter, six 8 mm holes at 37 mm radius, specified textured plates and 8 ± 0.1 mm probe with 0.8 mm chamfer.
Puncture setup load range must cause rupture between 10% and 90% of full-scale capacity.
Seam jig complies with ASTM D4884; clamps cover specimen width without damage, jaw width typically at least 225 mm and minimum 50 mm, loading rate 10 ± 3% per minute.
Burst jig complies with ASTM D6241 and includes the specified 150 mm cylinder, 50 ± 1 mm flat diameter and 2.5 ± 0.5 mm radial edge.
Burst clamping assembly: 150 mm internal and at least 250 mm external diameter, 11 mm holes on 220 mm circle, slippage under 5 mm, bolted plates and guide block.

cases.anchorText: between 10% and 90% of the full-scale load

expected.summary: Burst-test rupture occurs between 10% and 90% of UTM full-scale load.
Geogrid tensile jig complies with ASTM D6637; clamps span specimen width, minimum 200 mm jaw face, rupture at 10–90% full scale and strain rate 10 ± 3% per minute of gauge length.

Grab breaking/elongation jig complies with ASTM D4632; flat parallel non-slip clamps, one jaw face 25.4 × 50.8 mm with longer dimension parallel to load, aligned jaws, break at 10–90% full scale and controlled 300 ± 10 mm/min.
Software provides real-time graphing, zoom/magnification/compression/point tracing and multiple load/displacement units.
Software includes tensile stress, compression, cyclic loading and relaxation modules, and editable test programs.
Software supplies statistical analysis and plots for load-elongation, stress-strain, modulus, yield and proof stress.
Software permits custom reports and Word/Excel/ASCII/PDF export; supports specified/current and future jig tests; warranty/AMC updates free and later updates at reasonable charges.
Power supply: 220/380/400 V, 50/60 Hz, three phase.
